install_notes.note: MCT L2 and L4: install in the floor/ceiling slab and in the shelter opening; L1 and L3: install in the floor/ceiling slab.
MCT R: install in the ceiling slab where the cables go out to the roof.
Mounting opening size (W x H) is given under each MCT detail - cut/check the opening to that size before fixing the frame; frames are fixed through Ø10 holes (4, 6 or 8 per frame, see detail).
Seal the joint between frame flange and wall with intumescent tape; use module lubricant and the hold-down tool for 60 mm sections when packing modules (items in MCT list pos.26-28).
Frame kits (Type 1/2) come with mating frame, support plate, press block, assembly grease and sealing tape - check the kit is complete before installation.
Instrument MCTs: MCT provided by Gazprom Avtomatizatsiya (GA) for GLE cables - 20 mm modules to be provided by them; check bottom elevations and penetration sizes marked at each MCT on the plan.
Earthing strip passes through walls and slabs only in penetrations; no joints or branches inside the penetration. Seal the wall sleeve with fire-resistant mounting foam.
Cable penetrations through sandwich-panel walls are made in sleeves (item 23).
After all communication cables are laid, seal the cable routes through walls with fire-resistant intumescent sealant and a thermal insulating plate; install fire-stop barriers inside cable boxes.
Same sealing rule for LAN/alarm cables: seal wall passages with fire-resistant intumescent sealant and insulating plate after all cables are laid.
